resources.string: Car hotspot switch (experimental)

One request per tap using the Android 9 platform interface, not an ECARX-specific switch. Hotspot state does not prove internet access, iPhone connection or CarPlay readiness. This does not change saved hotspot details or automatic startup; an enabled automatic-start option may turn it on again at the next connection.
Turn hotspot on
Turn hotspot off
Refresh network state
A network switch operation is in progress. Wait before connecting or trying again.
Finish or disconnect CarPlay and wait for any connection or hotspot startup to end before changing Wi-Fi or the hotspot.
Turning the hotspot off disconnects every device using it and can interrupt CarPlay. Turn it off now?

The hotspot request failed. Check car settings; no automatic retry was made.
Disconnect CarPlay before switching Wi-Fi. If the hotspot is stuck, switch Wi-Fi on and off, then turn the hotspot on. This can interrupt Wi-Fi connections and the hotspot.
